title: The owner's second round of the day: the Rotor's reticle and the Quiver's round agree with the barrel again (the aim reads the record, the gun's box also takes the Pearl body); a hit is a red halo; the hover tank's pull longer and its pace in km/h over the radar; the integrity strip fades when nothing is lost; the canyon again entered from a manual SOL seat, tried in the browser
context: Owner, 2026-10-15, on f15e73a2 and 9d6b2ea6: '1) something broken with the ROTOR and Quiver POV, they both don't quite respond like before. ROTOR shooting is not always aligned with the reticle, and quiver final descent does not seem to follow the target as it should. 2) ideas to notes, not implement yet [2026-10-15-ideas-boss-fight-cave-descent-and-isaos-decoding]. 3) we will increase the hover tank's speed system whereby going forward and not hitting anything increases the speed, since there is no friction with the ground. We will display its speed in KM/H in small on the HUD above the RADAR 4) enemies hit by something but not dying should register the hit visually, with a temporary red halo. 5) the canyon plays well, part 1. 6) sector 7, the canyon again, I suspect that IF the user was manually controlling SOL, it becomes unavailable, the mission trigger should reset SOL. 7) the HUD for the Stalheart, gate, back health etc. they fade out if not used, they re-appear when challenged/under attack.' FOUND. (1) The first round (2026-10-15-fourteen-notes-on-the-shapes-build) moved the pilot's box test, the tracer's landing and the lance's aim to the Pearl body's own point while the barrel (src/fx/tower-aim.js, on pilotTarget.pos) and the guided round (towerSeekers, on the record) still went to the record: the tracer left the barrel at an angle and the missile descended on the record beside the body the reticle had locked. (3) TANK_DRIVE was already the pull asked for (base 1.35 easing to top 2.6 over tau 4 s; src/domain/drive-ramp.js); no readout existed. (4) The first round's flash was white, 0.6 strong, 0.18 s. (6) src/fx/laser-station.js passOver already leaves a taken seat and sits again for the laid pass (owner, 2026-10-05, sector 6); whether a seat taken by hand on a regular pass still breaks the canyon again was untested. (7) The integrity strip (src/fx/integrity-hud.js) stood at full opacity throughout.
outcome: (1) The aim reads the record again: src/sentry-pilot.js inBox tests the record's point, and for a gun (no lock cone) ALSO the Pearl body's own point (src/fx/lance-follow.js groundAt), so the reticle on the body registers (the first round's complaint) while the barrel, the tracer (tower-combat's hitP/at on target.pos) and the round go to the record, within about a radius of the body; bodyAt is the record's point again (lifted for a dot cloud); groundAt stays the ram's and the beam's. (3) TANK_DRIVE top 3.2 (was 2.6) over tau 6 s (was 4); src/fx/hull-speed.js (new): the hull's pace from frame to frame, smoothed, in km/h, a small line above the minimap (styles.css .hull-speed; not on a phone, not in a seat, not before the hull is issued); test/hull-drive.mjs's equivalence hash re-based for the new ramp (the recorded block's hash under top 2.6 / tau 4 is kept in the comment). (4) The hit is a red halo: the kit's fragment shader mixes toward red at the body's own brightness (0.85) and fills the membrane a little for it, over CREATURE_FOLLOW.flash 0.35 s. (6) scripts/browser-test.mjs --canyon-again under CANYON_SEATED=1: the player takes SOL-82 by hand on a regular pass before the canyon's pass is laid over him; the verdict is in the evidence. (7) integrity-hud: after CALM (8 s) with nothing lost the strip fades to 0.18 (styles.css .ih-calm, a 1.4 s ease); a loss on the Stalheart or a gate wakes it at once; `calm` in its state. (5) noted: the canyon's first part plays well.
alternatives: Make the barrel and the round fly at the body's point too: rejected for now; the body swings about its record each hop and the guided round's descent on a hopping point would wander, while the record is where the body's hunt keeps it.
A white flash kept, longer: rejected; the owner asked for red.
Fade the strip by distance from the fight instead of by time: rejected; a loss is the only thing the strip knows, and it is what the owner named.
evidence: node test/hull-speed.mjs, test/hull-drive.mjs (re-based), test/drive-ramp.mjs (still gaining for 12 s, settling at 3.2); npm test (259), npm run check (td-tab 6,126 under 6,400, the long-line budget held by src/fx/hull-speed.js), npm run build

browser, 2026-10-15: CANYON_SEATED=1 --canyon-again green: seated by hand on a regular pass before the canyon's pass (seated, overhead, special false), then SOL-82's canyon pass and its seat taken over it, 725 burned in 25 s (so note 6's suspicion did not reproduce on this path: the laid pass leaves a taken seat and sits again); --canyon-again, --pearl-story (the hull probes and the motion audit), --laser-game, --seats, --skip-tutorial, --sectors green. --tank-shell red ('the shell lands in the pile', no blast in 15 s) on this round AND on the committed 9d6b2ea6 with the round stashed: older than the round, bisected separately
